question: In the women's category, which athlete won the bronze medal at the 2023 Asian 20 km Walking Championships held in Nomi, Japan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Priyanka Goswami.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The athlete who won the** bronze medal** in the **women's category** at the** 2023 Asian 20 km Walking Championships** held in** Nomi, Japan** is **Priyanka Goswami.**
 
• Priyanka Goswami is an** Indian racewalker** who has been consistently performing well in various** national and international events.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhawna Jat **is also an** Indian racewalker** who won a **silver medal **in the **20 km** walk event at the **2019 Asian Race Walking Championships** held in Nomi, Japan.
 
• **Khushbir Kaur** is another Indian racewalker who has won several medals in national and international events, including a **silver medal** in the **20 km walk event** at the 2014 Asian Games held in** Incheon, South Korea.**
 
• **Manju Rani** is a boxer from India who won a** bronze medal** in the women's **48 kg category** at the **2019 AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships** held in **Ulan-Ude, Russia.**
